purpose: A dumped scope is a place in the source. Two classes of row are not: the sentinel 0:0..0:0, written when a node is recorded as having no position, and a negative range, written when a closed (line, column) interval is asked to express an empty one. Both are symptoms of one representation defect — the dump has no spelling for "no position" or "empty" that does not borrow a coordinate. This ledger used to name M3's extents as the cure and cite docs/reviews/2026-08-05-m3-endstate-poc.md as its authority; that design was reverted on 2026-08-07 (docs/reviews/2026-08-07-requirement-audit.md) and the cure is a dump spelling, not a substrate. Until it exists the counts may only shrink, with two recorded exceptions, both the same shape and both in regression.txt. First, its sentinel budget went 18 -> 19 on 2026-08-10, because the autolink position defect it now pins only appears on a paragraph whose buffer holds more than its first line, and a second line is a SoftBreak. The row is the same known class the ledger already tracks, not a new one. When every count reaches zero this ledger and scripts/audit-scope-sanity.mjs are deleted, not kept at zero. Second, at 0a.6 on 2026-08-21 the same budget went 16 -> 17: D7's fix needs a witness on a CONTINUATION line, because the term it restores is the line's column offset and that term is zero on the first line of a paragraph. A paragraph with a second line has a SoftBreak between them, and a SoftBreak is a sentinel by construction. The row is the known class, not a new one. regression.txt's budget is back where Stage 0a found it: 17 at the baseline, 16 after 0a.2 turned an unresolved footnote call's sentinel into a real position, 17 again here. The ledger total tracks it, 207 -> 206 -> 207. Third, at 0a.12 on 2026-08-21 the same budget went 17 -> 18, for the third time in the same shape: D19's start-line half has no witness in this repository at all -- reverting it alone leaves correctness 67/67 and all three position oracles green -- and the only input that exposes it is a link whose label crosses a line ending, which means a second line, which means a SoftBreak. The row is the known class, not a new one, and it is one of the 153 that D26 would clear if D26 lands. In the same commit extensions.txt's negative budget went 10 -> 7 (D20 gave the strikethrough delimiter run its end column), so the total is 207 -> 205: minus three real, plus one of the known shape. Fourth, at 0a.12b on 2026-08-21 extensions.txt's PARTIAL budget went 1 -> 2, and this one is a different shape and is recorded as such: D26 gave every SoftBreak and LineBreak a real position, and the one break inside the split-off table lead inherited its paragraph's line ZERO, so a sentinel became a line-zero column. It is not new wrongness -- that paragraph and both its Text children are already on line zero and are Step 10's -- but it is a lateral move, and lateral moves are what this ledger exists to catch. It was invisible: audit-scope-sanity.mjs measured `partial`, stored it and counted it in the total, and NEVER compared it against the budget. 0a.12b closes that hole, so this is the last lateral move that can pass silently. The same commit took the total 205 -> 52: five of the seven files leave the ledger entirely, and what remains is 37 sentinel (36 of them D13's empty Text, 0a.14's), 13 negative and 2 partial.
